rec.name: Cart Hide "Remove" Button Toggle

what.text: A theme-settings checkbox ("Hide remove button") in the Cart settings group that hides the "Remove" (Entfernen) text link on every line item in both the cart drawer (mini-cart) and the main cart page. It is off by default, so the link only disappears when merchants enable it. The ticket is labelled "Section", but the code is a global theme setting with Liquid conditionals, so it is better classified as a Feature.

why.text: Removing the easy exit from the cart reduces accidental or impulsive item deletions and keeps the cart value intact. The shopper's attention stays on the checkout CTA. Customers can still change quantity, so the path to removal is less prominent but not blocked. The effect is likely small and could frustrate users or hurt trust if removal is too hard, so it should be A/B tested. This reasoning is inferred, not stated in the ticket.

how.text: 1) In settings_schema.json, under the "Cart" group, add a checkbox setting with id cart_hide_remove_button, label "Hide remove button", default false. 2) In mini-cart.liquid, wrap the anchor with class line-item__remove-button in {% unless settings.cart_hide_remove_button %}...{% endunless %}. 3) In main-cart.liquid, wrap both the mobile (hidden-tablet-and-up) and desktop (hidden-phone) remove links in the same unless condition. The link keeps its url_to_remove and the translation key cart.general.remove.

items: Hide remove button (checkbox, default off) in Theme settings > Cart

dependencies.text: No metafields (ticket says MF/N). It assumes a theme with settings_schema.json, a "Cart" settings group, mini-cart.liquid and main-cart.liquid, and the .line-item__remove-button markup (Prestige-style theme, inferred from class names). No app is required. Because the setting is global, an A/B test needs a theme-level split or a test tool, since a theme setting alone cannot target a user segment.

items: Rate of line-item removals per cart

images.caption: Theme settings > Cart shows the "Hide remove button" toggle (off). The red arrow points to the "Entfernen" link in the cart drawer that the toggle controls.
